readme: This copy of the Power BI project has no row-level security: the role "Regional manager" and the
Security table are removed. Model and report are otherwise unchanged (tables, relationships, measures,
pages). It is the copy that Publish to web would use; the data are invented for a fictional company.
Built with: uv run python tools/pbi/make_public_variant.py
The project under pbip/ keeps the role for the row-level security demonstration.
